info.title: Cituro Universal API
info.description: Cituro is a cloud appointment booking and scheduling platform for businesses that manage bookings, customers, ratings, and related workflows.

get.description: Retrieves an appointment record from Cituro.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: appointmentId
parameters.description: Cituro appointment identifier from the appointment resource path.

schema.description: Cituro appointment identifier from the appointment resource path.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
